lede: The biggest item this week is Tuesday's BOCC meeting, where the county takes up two Land Use Code amendments — one updating rules for Natural Medicine Businesses and one addressing Nonconforming Lots, the kind of quiet code language that shapes what gets built and where for years to come. HARC meets the same day with a full plate: accessibility renovations at Town Hall, a floor-area addition at the Parks & Rec office, and three preliminary large-scale public hearings on the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave. Monday afternoon, the Open Space Commission holds a public weed pull on the Valley Floor with public comment open to anyone who shows up.
